title: Cocco: Hardware-Mapping Co-Exploration towards Memory Capacity-Communication Optimization
problem: DNN accelerators face a fundamental trade-off between on-chip memory capacity needed to reduce data movement overhead and silicon costs, and existing memory-oriented optimizations are insufficiently general to handle diverse DNN graph structures.
motivation: Memory design is critical for DNN accelerators as it directly determines energy consumption, bandwidth requirements, and area costs.
method: Cocco performs co-exploration of hardware mapping configurations to jointly optimize memory capacity and communication patterns. The approach leverages data reuse optimization and layer fusion techniques across different hardware-mapping combinations to find better trade-offs between capacity requirements and data movement.
key_novelty: A co-exploration framework that jointly optimizes hardware mapping and memory capacity decisions to address the capacity-communication trade-off in DNN accelerators.
contributions: Co-exploration framework for simultaneous hardware mapping and memory configuration optimization
Solution to capacity-communication trade-off in memory-constrained DNN accelerators
Support for diverse and complex DNN graph structures
Generalized approach superseding prior memory-oriented optimization schemes
limitations: Specific experimental results, performance metrics, and comparison with state-of-the-art baselines are not discussed in the abstract.
primary_theme: Co-exploration of hardware mapping and memory capacity for DNN accelerators
